item.title: Reflections on an Annual Backpacking Trip
item.description: An annual Point Reyes backpacking trip, revisited through years of film photos, becomes a reflection on how the same place can remain emotionally vivid through shifting landscapes, changing company, and the quiet intentionality of memory.
